system.description: Engage a creature with a notable Beast in a Social Challenge (mortals and ghouls must bid an extra Trait or relent; against more powerful creatures you must bid an extra Trait). If you win, the target must obey your commands as long as you keep your attention on it and it remains in sight; there is no loyalty, only cowed submission. Your target must be able to understand your commands.
system.duration: As long as attention is maintained
